title: Physics material updates done in _integrate_forces are always left over to next frame
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.3, steam build



### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable (7d41c59c4) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9649) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 61.66 GiB memory

### Issue description

In the game i'm working on, i need to detect which section of the body is colliding before resolving how far the body will bounce. So i used _integrate_forces in my RigidBody3D that uses PhysicsDirectBodyState3D data for contact location and update physics_material_override.bounce attribute.

In short, i expect _integrate_forces to have full collision information and full physics manipulation in the *current* frame

### Steps to reproduce

here is a very simple script example for re-producing (make sure you drop the object from a high position onto a collider:
```gdscript
extends RigidBody3D

func _ready(delta):
	physics_material_override.bounce = 1.0

# this is set to update the material once it has a contact, the object will bounce on first contact, but stick on second
func _integrate_forces(state):
	var contact_count = state.get_contact_count()
	if contact_count > 0:
		physics_material_override.bounce = 0.0
```

i dont think the object should bounce in the first contact
